pay_detail: Nonrefundable enrollment fee; the amount is not posted. Email wsbprecollege@wsb.wisc.edu about fees and financial help.
duration: 4 days, 9 am to 4 pm. Session 1: June 21 to 24, 2027. Session 2: June 28 to July 1, 2027
name: Junior Business Badgers
what_you_do: A day camp at Grainger Hall that runs 4 days. Students explore business careers, visit local companies for job shadow trips, and get help with college essays and resumes.
who_can_apply: Rising 11th and 12th grade students interested in business. Preference goes to first-generation college students and students who get free or reduced lunch, but others can apply and may be waitlisted.
deadline_text: Applications are open December 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Pick one session. A session may be canceled if enrollment is low.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the precollege page. If accepted, a parent signs waivers and pays the fee.
notes: Past field trip sites named on the page include Trek Bikes and Epic. Not residential.
